description: Feature contract v2 for the 1m-regime / 30s-checkpoint collector. Snap semantics match collector_v2_spec.md §3.5 / §5.5 / §7.1. Any change to names, definitions, null policy, default values, or snap-call-order requires a new contract version (v3). Deferred features per §15.10 are not included and will enter v2.1.

role_taxonomy.model_feature: Actively used as ML model input. Varies across events and/or checkpoints.
role_taxonomy.metadata_only: Emitted in the feature table for downstream filtering or stratification but MUST NOT be used as ML model input.
role_taxonomy.compat_alias: Stores the same numeric value as another named feature (see `alias_of` in the feature entry). Kept for contract stability / semantic clarity with prior spec text. NOT recommended for ML inclusion alongside its source feature (redundant information).
role_taxonomy.constant_by_construction: Value is fixed by the event-definition rules (e.g., always 1 for every emitted event). Zero-variance; NOT useful as a model feature. Kept for contract stability and as a sanity-check column.

null_policy_docs.disallow: Column must be present and non-null for every emitted row. A null in this column is a bug and the row should not be emitted.
null_policy_docs.nullable_explicit: Column MUST exist in every row (required column), but values MAY be null under documented conditions (e.g., 'no prior regime exists'). Downstream consumers must handle null.
null_policy_docs.default_filled: Column is always populated. If the natural computation is undefined (e.g., zero denominator), the contract-specified default is used.

snap_call_order_anchors.signal_time_root: Snap at bar+1 close (signal_time) inside _check_confirmation, AFTER atr_14.update_raw(bar1), AFTER regime_1m.update(bar1), AFTER _update_5m(bar1) if bar1 is a 5m boundary, BEFORE the event is appended to the active-trades collection. Indicator state reflects all bars with ts_init <= signal_time.
snap_call_order_anchors.checkpoint_time_dynamic: Snap at decision_time inside _snap_checkpoint(T, current_ts) called from _emit_30s_bar at NT processing time ts_init = decision_time + 1s. Ordering per §5.5: 30s aggregation fires first, then checkpoint snap reads regime_30s / regime_5m / regime_1m state AFTER the 30s update but BEFORE any 1m-bar update at the same shared ts_init.
snap_call_order_anchors.static_per_event: Constant per event; set at registration, never updates.
snap_call_order_anchors.checkpoint_derived: Derived at decision_time from indicator/state values snapped in checkpoint_time_dynamic. No additional state; pure function of snap-time inputs.
snap_call_order_anchors.post_signal_evolution: Computed at decision_time from the 1s-bar buffer spanning [signal_time, decision_time]. Buffer is append-only; decision_time values reflect only bars with ts_event <= decision_time.

decision_time_definitions.signal_time: bar+1 close timestamp (ts_event of bar+1 + 60e9 ns)
decision_time_definitions.execution_price: open of the 30s bar covering [fill_time, fill_time + 30s)

runtime_execution_assumption: Decide at checkpoint-bar close, fill at open of 30s bar starting at fill_time. Labels ONLY valid for strategies matching this execution model (see §7.1).
ml_usage_guidance: Use ONLY features where role == 'model_feature' as ML model inputs. Features with role 'compat_alias' duplicate information already present in their alias_of source. 'constant_by_construction' features have zero variance within the v2 event family. 'metadata_only' features are for research filtering and stratification, never direct model input. This partition is enforced at the contract level; downstream ML training code should reject or warn on accidental inclusion of non-model-feature columns.

features.name: signal_direction
features.definition: +1 long, -1 short — signed direction of the confirmed flip.

features.name: atr_at_signal
features.definition: NT AverageTrueRange(14) value at signal_time, after bar+1 has been included in the indicator state. Canonical normalization denominator across the event.
features.notes: Wilder smoothing accumulates FP drift; loose tolerance

features.name: atr_at_checkpoint
features.definition: ATR(14) value at decision_time. Not used for normalization; provided raw for research into intra-event ATR drift.

features.name: flip_vol_vs_20avg
features.definition: flip_bar.v / mean volume of 20 prior 1m bars

features.name: flip_bar_vol_rank_20
features.definition: Rank of flip.v among prior 20 1m bar volumes, [0, 1]

features.name: bar1_upper_wick_pct
features.definition: bar1 upper wick fraction of range

features.name: bar1_lower_wick_pct
features.definition: bar1 lower wick fraction of range

features.name: bar1_vol_rank_20
features.definition: bar1 volume rank vs prior 20 1m bars

features.name: bar1_close_above_50pct_range
features.definition: 1 if bar1.close_location in favor of direction else 0

features.name: bar1_confirmed_hh_ll
features.definition: 1 if HH (long) or LL (short) confirmed — by construction always 1 for events in this lineage; retained for contract stability
features.notes: Always 1 for every emitted event (the v2 event definition requires bar+1 HH/LL confirmation as a precondition for emission).

features.name: two_bar_vol_vs_40avg
features.definition: (flip.v + bar1.v) / mean of prior 40 1m bar volumes

features.name: flip_low_to_bar1_high_atr
features.definition: Same as two_bar_range_atr (legacy alias retained for contract stability)

features.name: pre_3_body_efficiency
features.definition: abs(B[3].close - B[1].open) / sum(B[j].high - B[j].low for j=1..3), 0 if denom==0

features.name: pre_3_close_near_high_fraction
features.definition: count(j in 1..3 with (B[j].close-B[j].low)/(B[j].high-B[j].low) >= 0.75) / 3 (bars with range=0 excluded from both numerator and denominator)

features.name: pre_3_close_near_low_fraction
features.definition: count(j in 1..3 with (B[j].close-B[j].low)/(B[j].high-B[j].low) <= 0.25) / 3 (bars with range=0 excluded from both numerator and denominator)

features.name: pre_3_mean_body_pct
features.definition: mean over j in 1..3 of |B[j].close - B[j].open| / max(B[j].high - B[j].low, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_3_mean_wickiness
features.definition: mean over j in 1..3 of (B[j].high - max(B[j].open, B[j].close) + min(B[j].open, B[j].close) - B[j].low) / max(B[j].high - B[j].low, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_5_body_efficiency
features.definition: abs(B[5].close - B[1].open) / sum(B[j].high - B[j].low for j=1..5), 0 if denom==0

features.name: pre_5_close_near_high_fraction
features.definition: count(j in 1..5 with (B[j].close-B[j].low)/(B[j].high-B[j].low) >= 0.75) / 5 (bars with range=0 excluded from both numerator and denominator)

features.name: pre_5_close_near_low_fraction
features.definition: count(j in 1..5 with (B[j].close-B[j].low)/(B[j].high-B[j].low) <= 0.25) / 5 (bars with range=0 excluded from both numerator and denominator)

features.name: pre_5_mean_body_pct
features.definition: mean over j in 1..5 of |B[j].close - B[j].open| / max(B[j].high - B[j].low, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_5_mean_wickiness
features.definition: mean over j in 1..5 of (B[j].high - max(B[j].open, B[j].close) + min(B[j].open, B[j].close) - B[j].low) / max(B[j].high - B[j].low, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_10_body_efficiency
features.definition: abs(B[10].close - B[1].open) / sum(B[j].high - B[j].low for j=1..10), 0 if denom==0

features.name: pre_10_close_near_high_fraction
features.definition: count(j in 1..10 with (B[j].close-B[j].low)/(B[j].high-B[j].low) >= 0.75) / 10 (bars with range=0 excluded from both numerator and denominator)

features.name: pre_10_close_near_low_fraction
features.definition: count(j in 1..10 with (B[j].close-B[j].low)/(B[j].high-B[j].low) <= 0.25) / 10 (bars with range=0 excluded from both numerator and denominator)

features.name: pre_10_mean_body_pct
features.definition: mean over j in 1..10 of |B[j].close - B[j].open| / max(B[j].high - B[j].low, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_10_mean_wickiness
features.definition: mean over j in 1..10 of (B[j].high - max(B[j].open, B[j].close) + min(B[j].open, B[j].close) - B[j].low) / max(B[j].high - B[j].low, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_signal_body_compression_3v10
features.definition: mean(|c-o|) over last_3 / max(mean over prior_7, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_signal_vol_compression_3v10
features.definition: mean(vol) over last_3 / max(mean over prior_7, 1e-9)

features.name: pre_signal_breakout_from_compression_flag
features.definition: 1 if range_compression_3v10 < 0.6 AND flip_range_atr > 1.5 × mean_range(last_3)/atr_at_signal else 0

features.name: position_in_recent_range_10
features.definition: (flip.close - min_low_10) / max(max_high_10 - min_low_10, 1e-9); 0.5 if denom=0; range [0,1]

features.name: failed_push_count_pre_signal
features.definition: count j in 2..10 where (B[j].h > B[j-1].h AND B[j].c < B[j-1].h) OR (B[j].l < B[j-1].l AND B[j].c > B[j-1].l). Previous-bar reference.

features.name: pre_signal_trend_efficiency_5
features.definition: |B[5].c - B[1].o| / sum of ranges, 0 if denom=0, range [0,1]

features.name: pre_signal_directional_consistency_5
features.definition: count of bars with sign(B[j].c - B[j-1].c) == sign(B[5].c - B[1].o) / (5-1)

features.name: pre_signal_trend_efficiency_10
features.definition: |B[10].c - B[1].o| / sum of ranges, 0 if denom=0, range [0,1]

features.name: pre_signal_directional_consistency_10
features.definition: count of bars with sign(B[j].c - B[j-1].c) == sign(B[10].c - B[1].o) / (10-1)

features.name: prior_regime_duration_bars
features.definition: Number of 1m bars the prior regime lasted from its own flip through the bar BEFORE the current flip_bar (inclusive)

features.name: prior_regime_mfe_atr
features.definition: Peak favorable excursion of the immediately prior regime, from that prior regime's bar+1 close, normalized by atr_at_signal of CURRENT event. NaN if no prior or prior unconfirmed.

features.name: regime_flips_last_30min
features.definition: Count of regime flips in the 30 1m bars prior to signal_time

features.name: regime_flips_last_60min
features.definition: Count of regime flips in the 60 1m bars prior to signal_time

features.name: avg_regime_duration_last_5
features.definition: Mean duration in 1m bars of the last 5 fully completed regimes before current signal. NaN if < 1 completed.

features.name: consecutive_trend_bars_pre_flip
features.definition: Consecutive same-direction close-to-close moves in the 5 1m bars prior to flip_bar

features.name: atr_14
features.definition: Same as atr_at_signal. Duplicate column kept for contract stability with v1 consumers.
features.notes: Same value as atr_at_signal. Retained for legacy consumers.

features.name: price_vs_sma20_atr
features.definition: (flip.c - sma20_1m.value) / atr_at_signal; sma includes flip bar

features.name: vol_acceleration_5bar
features.definition: (last 5 avg vol - prior 5 avg vol) / prior 5 avg vol; 0.0 default

features.name: high_vol_bar_count_10
features.definition: Count of last 10 bars with vol > 1.5 × vol_1m_20avg (int)

features.name: cumulative_volume_bias_10
features.definition: sum(up_vol - down_vol) / sum(total_vol) over last 10 1m bars

features.name: distance_from_session_high_atr
features.definition: (session_high - flip.c) / atr_at_signal. Session resets at 17:00 CT.

features.name: session_bars_since_open
features.definition: 1m bars elapsed since current session start (0 = first bar)

features.name: session_warmup_flag
features.notes: Research-side filter flag (per §3.6). NOT a model input; session bars_since_open is the informative signal.

features.name: checkpoint_s
features.definition: T_d in seconds (0, 30, 60, ...). Same as decision_checkpoint_s.

features.name: checkpoint_bars_since_signal_1m
features.definition: checkpoint_s // 60 — number of complete 1m bars between signal and this checkpoint.

features.name: time_since_last_1m_bar_close_s
features.definition: Seconds since the most recent 1m bar close at or before decision_time. 0 if decision_time is itself a 1m boundary.

features.name: time_until_next_1m_bar_close_s
features.definition: Seconds until the next 1m bar close after decision_time.

features.name: time_until_next_5m_bar_close_s
features.definition: Seconds until the next 5m bar close (minute_of_hour % 5 == 4) after decision_time.

features.name: bar_range_30s_current_atr
features.definition: Range of in-progress 30s bar: (max_h - min_l of buffered 1s) / atr_at_signal; 0.0 if buffer empty

features.name: bar_body_30s_current_atr
features.definition: abs(last_1s_close - first_1s_open in buffer) / atr_at_signal; 0.0 if buffer empty

features.name: regime_1m_direction
features.definition: regime_1m.regime at decision_time. For events where regime is still active, equals signal_direction. ∈ {-1, 1}.

features.name: ema3_slope_5m_atr
features.definition: (ema3_5m.value - ema3_5m 5 bars ago) / atr_at_signal; 0.0 if insufficient history

features.name: micro_same_dir_count_12s
features.definition: count of last 12 1s bars with close moving in trade direction

features.name: micro_opp_dir_count_12s
features.definition: count of last 12 1s bars with close moving opposite

features.name: micro_range_compression
features.definition: mean range last 6 1s / mean range prior 6 1s; 1.0 if denom=0

features.name: micro_body_pct_avg
features.definition: mean of |c-o|/max(h-l,1e-9) across last 12 1s bars; 0.5 default

features.name: max_progress_since_signal_atr
features.definition: max(0, max_j((max_favorable_price_j - bar1.close) × d)) / atr_at_signal; clipped >= 0

features.name: max_pullback_since_signal_atr
features.definition: max(0, max_j((bar1.close - min_favorable_price_j) × d)) / atr_at_signal; always >= 0

features.name: current_pullback_from_local_peak_atr
features.definition: (max_progress_price - last_1s_close) × d / atr_at_signal; 0 if no progress achieved (T_peak == signal_time); always >= 0

features.name: continuation_count_since_signal
features.definition: count of 1m bars in (signal_time, decision_time] where bar.high > prev.high (long) or bar.low < prev.low (short)

features.name: consecutive_continuation_bars
features.definition: longest run of consecutive continuation bars ending at the most recent completed 1m bar <= decision_time

features.name: bars_since_last_continuation
features.definition: number of 1m bars since the most recent continuation, counted from the most recent completed 1m bar <= decision_time

features.name: new_progress_in_last_30s_flag
features.definition: 1 if max_progress was achieved in [decision_time - 30s, decision_time] else 0

features.name: new_progress_in_last_60s_flag
features.definition: 1 if max_progress achieved in last 60s else 0

features.name: stall_60s_flag
features.definition: 1 if (decision_time - T_peak) > 60s else 0, where T_peak is the earliest 1s bar achieving max_progress. If max_progress = 0 then T_peak = signal_time.

features.name: extension_from_signal_atr
features.definition: Alias for current_progress_atr — kept for semantic clarity with §6.5 text
features.notes: Same value as current_progress_atr; kept for §6.5 semantic clarity.

features.name: extension_from_last_pullback_atr
features.definition: (last_1s_close - min_favorable_price_since_T_peak) × d / atr_at_signal. 'How much has price risen from the most recent local low since the peak?' >= 0 by construction.

features.name: minute_of_hour_checkpoint
features.definition: Minute of hour CT at decision_time

deferred_features_note: See §15.10: pre_signal_expansion_after_compression_flag, failed_continuation_count, compression_after_extension_flag, reversal_pressure_flag, momentum_decay_flag are deferred to a future contract version.
